prompt: How many times has the Turing Award been given to multiple winners in the same year?
answer:
As of the latest announced award (2025), the Turing Award has been given to multiple winners in the same year **18 times**.

The commonly cited figure of **16** applies through 2020; the 2024 and 2025 awards added two more multiple-winner years.
